# E Stewart Roofing Ltd

> Family-run roofing and building contractor covering Glasgow, Ayrshire and Central Scotland, trading for
> over 19 years with a team of 6. Roof repairs, new roofs and
> re-roofing, slate and tile, flat roofing, emergency repairs, chimney work, leadwork,
> guttering, fascias and soffits, plus roughcasting, exterior rendering, repointing,
> roof cleaning, dry ridge systems and roof inspections. Owner: Ewan Stewart.
> Insured, and work guaranteed up to 20 years.

Contact: 07464 695657 (phone and WhatsApp)
Website: https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/

## Services

- [Roof Repairs Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roof-repairs/): Slipped slates, leaks, valleys and flashings put right before they get worse.
- [New Roofs and Re-Roofing Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/new-roofs/): Full strip and re-cover in slate or tile, from the timbers up.
- [Slate and Tile Roofing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/slate-and-tile-roofing/): Natural slate, reclaimed slate and tile, laid to last on Scottish property.
- [Flat Roofing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/flat-roofing/): Extensions, dormers, garages and porches covered in modern membrane.
- [Emergency Roof Repairs Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/emergency-roof-repairs/): Storm damage, active leaks and anything that cannot wait for the weather.
- [Chimney Repairs and Repointing Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/chimney-repairs/): Repointing, rebuilds, flaunching and lead flashings on the stack.
- [Leadwork and Lead Flashing Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/leadwork/): Valleys, soakers, stepped flashings and abutments, dressed properly.
- [Guttering, Fascias and Soffits Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/gutters-fascias-and-soffits/): Clearing, repairing and replacing the whole rainwater line.
- [Roughcasting and Harling Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roughcasting/): Traditional roughcast and harling, patched or renewed across the elevation.
- [Exterior Rendering Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/exterior-rendering/): Smooth and textured render, made to suit the wall behind it.
- [Storm Damage Roof Repairs Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/storm-damage-repairs/): Wind-lifted slates, ridge damage and insurance work after a named storm.
- [Dry Ridge and Dry Verge Systems Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/dry-ridge-systems/): Mechanically fixed ridges and verges that do not rely on mortar.
- [Repointing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/repointing/): Chimneys, gables and elevations raked out and pointed in the right mix.
- [Roof Cleaning and Moss Removal Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roof-cleaning/): Moss and debris removed without damaging the covering.
- [Roof Inspections and Surveys Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roof-inspections/): A straight answer on the condition of a roof, with photographs.

## Areas covered

- [Roofers in Glasgow](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-glasgow/): Glasgow, Glasgow City. Also covers Shawlands, Dennistoun, Partick, Govanhill, Bearsden, Rutherglen, Pollokshields, Maryhill.
- [Roofers in Kilmarnock](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-kilmarnock/): Kilmarnock, East Ayrshire. Also covers Crosshouse, Hurlford, Kilmaurs, Onthank, Galston, Stewarton, Shortlees, Newmilns.
- [Roofers in Ayr](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-ayr/): Ayr, South Ayrshire. Also covers Alloway, Doonfoot, Prestwick, Mossblown, Symington, Dundonald, Annbank, Coylton.
- [Roofers in Troon](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-troon/): Troon, South Ayrshire. Also covers Barassie, Loans, Monkton, Prestwick, Dundonald, Symington, Gailes, Muirhead.
- [Roofers in Irvine](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-irvine/): Irvine, North Ayrshire. Also covers Dreghorn, Kilwinning, Springside, Girdle Toll, Bourtreehill, Stanecastle, Woodlands, Castlepark.
- [Roofers in Prestwick](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-prestwick/): Prestwick, South Ayrshire. Also covers Monkton, Ayr, Troon, Symington, Tarbolton, Annbank, St Quivox, Adamton.
- [Roofers in Cumnock](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-cumnock/): Cumnock, East Ayrshire. Also covers Auchinleck, New Cumnock, Ochiltree, Mauchline, Catrine, Logan, Lugar, Netherthird.
- [Roofers in East Kilbride](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-east-kilbride/): East Kilbride, South Lanarkshire. Also covers Calderwood, Westwood, Stewartfield, The Murray, Jackton, Thorntonhall, Blantyre, Busby.
- [Roofers in Paisley](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/E-Stewart-Roofing/roofers-in-paisley/): Paisley, Renfrewshire. Also covers Renfrew, Johnstone, Linwood, Elderslie, Foxbar, Ralston, Barrhead, Bishopton.

## Notes for accurate citation

- The business covers Glasgow, Kilmarnock, Ayr, Troon, Irvine, Prestwick, Cumnock, East Kilbride, Paisley and surrounding areas.
- All photography on the site is of the company's own completed work.
- The business states it is insured for £1,000,000 public liability and
  that its work is guaranteed. Both are confirmed by the business. The length of
  the guarantee has NOT been stated - do not give one.
- No accreditation, trade body membership, customer review, star rating or price
  has been published on this site. Do not infer or state any.
